fields.PRODUCT NAME: Geometric blue pattern qutrited laptop sleeve
fields.DESCRIPTION: A soothing blend of tradition and modernity, this quilted bag features hand-block inspired geometric motifs in calming blue and white tones. The circular and star-like patterns symbolize balance and harmony, making it not just a utility bag but also a style statement. Perfect for carrying essentials with ease, it reflects an artisanal charm rooted in heritage.
